title: Story premise EDU086: The Tiny Button Has Neighbors
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (accessibility/inclusion). Hook: Which target did this tap actually hit? Takeaway/theme: Interactive target size and spacing affect how forgiving a control layout is.
description: A person wants to select one control, but tightly packed small targets make unintended neighbors easy to hit in a toy interface. A revised layout enlarges and separates targets without changing their functions.
